response.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG(CASE WHEN spent <> 0 THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0) END) AS avg_rel_overspend, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count FROM cat), kept AS (SELECT cat.category, cat.avg_rel_overspend, cat.line_count, overall.avg_line_count FROM cat CROSS JOIN overall WHERE cat.line_count > overall.avg_line_count) SELECT AVG(avg_rel_overspend) AS avg_of_avg_rel_overspend, AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count_of_kept, AVG(line_count - avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: The average line count per category is computed across all categories (before filtering), as the plain average of per-category line counts.

Lines with NULL spent or NULL/zero amount are excluded from the relative overspend average (zero amount would make division undefined) but still count as lines. Lines with NULL category form their own group.
Categories whose lines are all excluded from the overspend calculation have a NULL average, which is ignored in the final average of averages.
